hypotheses: iaso puts each question to the owner through the question tool. When the question has more to see than fits in it (a diagram, long evidence, whole versions side by side), one of its options is to study it in the room; choosing that opens the study room on that question, and the question waits there. The owner can also ask for the room at any time. The room never opens by itself, shows one question at a time with Back and Next, grouped as waiting, being processed, blocked (with the reason) and done; an answered question leaves the waiting list at once, and one whose record changed after it was shown is blocked, not applied.
given a question whose options fit in a few lines, when iaso puts it to the owner, then it comes through the question tool, with no option to study it in the room

given a question that needs a diagram, when iaso puts it to the owner, then it comes through the question tool with an option 'study it in the room'; the room does not open unless that option is chosen
given the owner chooses 'study it in the room', when the answer is applied, then the room opens on that question with its diagram, and the question waits there until answered
given three questions wait in the room, the second carrying a diagram, when the owner opens the room and presses Next, then it shows the second question with its diagram above it and '2 of 3'
given the owner answers a question in the room, when the next prompt or turn end lists what waits, then that question is not among them
